rows.question: What is the area of the 150 mm slab-on-grade in m²?
rows.key: 6200 x 9950 mm by the printed dimensions (61.69 m2), less the two trenches drawn inside the slab: the motor control center trench (printed length 725 + 3550 = 4275 mm) and the pump control panel trench (printed length 1825 mm). Their widths are not printed on this sheet; on the drawing both are about 0.40 m wide: 61.69 - 4.275 x 0.40 - 1.825 x 0.39 = 59.27 m2. Until 14 Nov 23:50 this key was the plain rectangle, 61.69.
rows.explanation: 61.69 m² − 2.37 m² = 59.32 m². 61.69 m² by the printed dimensions. Taken out: MOTOR CONTROL CENTER TRENCH: 4.28 m × 0.40 m = 1.70 m²; PUMP CONTROL PANEL TRENCH: 1.75 m × 0.39 m = 0.67 m². Their size is not printed on this sheet, so each was measured where it is drawn, against a dimension printed on the plan (9950 mm = 2,350 px; both ends moved onto the lines that cross it). Both examiners found them and the measurements agree. Also seen and not added, its size not being printed: doorway slab extension at M8/S-500F; doorway slab extension at A6/S-500F; doorway threshold extension of 150 mm slab-on-grade at south.
